angle: level, lying on the grass at the child's eye-line
start_frame: Low profile close: her flushed face on the grass, out-of-focus stems crossing the near foreground, the fallen daisy on her pinafore in the lower corner, her eyes still open.
end_frame: The identical frame with her eyes closed and staying closed — the last two seconds of the shot are held on the shut eyes and the drifting grass.
constraint_honoured: 'The closed-eye hold runs a real two seconds' — nothing in the camera changes across that hold, so the nap plants itself instead of being announced.
movement_note: Any camera event here would read as the transition; the register change into S03 must be carried by silence alone.
